sentences.en: Wollongong is a beautiful coastal city in New South Wales, Australia.
sentences.zh: 卧龙岗是澳大利亚新南威尔士州的一个美丽的沿海城市。

sentences.en: I studied at the University of Wollongong for two years.
sentences.zh: 我在卧龙岗大学学习了两年。

sentences.en: Wollongong has a great surfing beach that attracts many visitors during summer months.
sentences.zh: 卧龙岗有一个很棒的冲浪海滩，夏天有很多游客去那里。
